correctness.rationale: The complete eight-inequality Kunz criterion and maximal Apéry-poset characterization force exactly three potential consecutive residue pairs. The middle pair is contradictory; the outer pairs yield precisely two integer parameter cones, with direct converse. Exact semigroup genera, Frobenius numbers, embedding dimensions and integer interval counts follow. Independent membership enumeration of all 32,065 valid Kunz tuples at genus <=60 identified precisely the predicted 88 cases, including 57 of embedding dimension four; intervals for sums <=1000 also agree. Finite checks are supporting evidence, not a substitute for the proof. Risks: only standard Apéry/Kunz theory is invoked without a general reproof.
